project_type: Next.js 14 app with App Router, shadcn/ui, recharts, framer-motion
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build with NODE_OPTIONS='' to verify no TypeScript/build errors
environment_constraints: NODE_OPTIONS must be cleared before running pnpm build/test due to sandbox proxy-bootstrap issue. No database available. DEMO_MODE=true on Vercel.
key_patterns: Components in src/components/ using 'use client' directive. UI components from shadcn/ui in src/components/ui/. Metrics components in src/components/metrics/. API routes in src/app/api/. framer-motion for animations. recharts for all charts (AreaChart, LineChart, RadialBarChart available).
directory_structure: src/app/ (Next.js app router pages/api), src/components/dashboard/ (dashboard page components), src/components/metrics/ (metric visualization components), src/components/ui/ (shadcn/ui base components), src/lib/ (utilities, auth, prisma)
